observations.behavior: Adds page-size and page-boundary parameters, a new condition-builder, page-bound query, page-key selection, and a page-aware batch reader; also adds a helper to detect ClickHouse query-memory or row-limit errors.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse ingestion connector; PAGED_READ_INITIAL_ROWS and PAGED_READ_MIN_ROWS establish page sizes for re-reading a table when a host's per-query result or memory cap is hit; page-boundary and page-condition helpers support page-aware batch reading; _is_query_limit_exceeded detects memory or row-limit errors.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to build WHERE conditions from incremental-field and row-filter inputs, including cursor and filter conditions.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse ingestion connector; _build_conditions constructs WHERE conditions for incremental-field and row-filter inputs, including cursor and filter conditions.

observations.behavior: Adds page_conditions parameter to _build_query, which is used to construct page-aware queries.
observations.posthog_connection: ClickHouse ingestion connector; page_conditions parameter added to _build_query, which is used to construct page-aware queries.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test file. While it adds assertions and setup for ClickHouse paged-read behavior, it does not change production implementation, configuration, or shared library behavior. No score can be assigned without the corresponding implementation change.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test case and a PagedReadFallback test class with fixtures and parametrized assertions.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the ClickHouse ingestion path does not fall back to page-based queries when a limit error occurs after rows were read, and that incremental paging respects warehouse-imposed row limits.
